name: Elopura Marathon Sandakan 2026
short_description: A full marathon event in Sandakan, Sabah, Malaysia, taking place on November 22, 2026, with 10km, half marathon, and full marathon distance options.
ai_summary: The Elopura Marathon Sandakan 2026 is a full marathon event scheduled for November 22, 2026, in Sandakan, Sabah, Malaysia. Organized by Persatuan Ortopedik Sandakan, it offers three distance options: a 10km, a half marathon (21.1km), and a full marathon (42.195km). Pricing is listed as MYR RM140 for the half marathon and RM170 for the full marathon, per elopuramarathon.com. Registration has not yet been announced.
